column1: # CI checks. starter is the default for everyone, on the site and in the CLI; a plan can turn r-cmd-check-extended off
# (lists/plans.tsv). events: pr, push, schedule, manual, comma separated; a check with schedule runs weekly. platforms is
# empty for Linux-only checks. label goes in the workflows README; help is the site's longer tip.

column3: R CMD check, the core check
column10: R CMD check, the core check. It runs on every pull request and push, and weekly.

column10: Checks style, that the docs are in sync, and spelling.

column10: Catches passwords and tokens committed by mistake.

column3: Run every test, including the browser, snapshot and extended tests CRAN skips, with Chrome for browser tests
column10: Runs every test, including the ones CRAN skips: test files ending in -browser, -snap or -extended. Runs on Linux.

column3: Run R CMD check on more systems (Mac and Windows for a public package), with the extended tests
column10: Every week, R CMD check on more systems (Mac and Windows for a public package), with the test files ending in -extended.
